name: vaultline-workspace
description: Repository root for Vaultline: the editor-agnostic detection engine (@vaultline/core, packages/core) and the VS Code host that embeds it (packages/vscode-extension). The engine has no editor dependency and can be extracted with `git subtree split --prefix=packages/core` if a second host ever needs it.
//workspaces: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace. vsce resolves an extension's shippable files by running `npm list` in the extension directory, and inside a workspace npm answers for the whole repo — so vsce walks the entire tree and collects files from outside the package. Each package installs its own node_modules instead; scripts/setup.js does both.

scripts.//compile: Order matters: the extension type-checks against the core's emitted .d.ts, so the core builds first.
scripts.compile: npm --prefix packages/core run compile && npm --prefix packages/vscode-extension run compile
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm --prefix packages/vscode-extension run package
scripts.package:platforms: npm run compile && npm --prefix packages/vscode-extension run package:platforms
